intents.subject: tockmox-ai->internet
intents.basis: ai-default-deny: default-deny-egress; only litellm is allowed 0.0.0.0/0:443

intents.subject: tockmox-diagnostic->internet
intents.basis: diagnostic default-deny Ingress+Egress; egress allowed only to DNS, API, monitoring

intents.subject: tockmox-platform->internet
intents.basis: platform-netpol header: egress is wide by design (Longhorn, ACME, Barman)

intents.subject: tockmox-monitoring->internet
intents.basis: monitoring bundle: ingress-only by design

intents.subject: tockmox-ai->kube-api
intents.basis: API egress in tockmox-ai is pod-scoped (cnpg, restore-drill); an arbitrary ai pod has none

intents.subject: tockmox-diagnostic->kube-api
intents.basis: allow-dns-api-telemetry: the diagnostic agent needs the API
